component.name: forge
component.purpose: Use when a new skill must be created from a decision, verdict, or capability gap — the user says "forge a skill", "turn this verdict into a skill", "build a skill for X", or pantheon/nexus hands over a VERDICT recommending one. Produces a secure, evaluated, quarantined skill package with an AI-BOM.

threat_note: Static scan only; runtime behaviour gated by eval + human promotion.
